article.title: Suicide blast targeting DI Khan police checkpost claims 12 lives, injures 30
article.summary: DERA ISMAIL KHAN: A dozen people lost their lives while 35 others were injured on Saturday when a vehicle laden with explosives was rammed into the Aman Mela police checkpost in Dera Ismail Khan’s Darazinda tehsil, officials said.Separately, a rescue worker was killed and two others were injured when a Rescue 1122 ambulance came under fire while transporting bodies of victims from the blast.DI Khan Regional Police Officer (RPO) Ghulam Mubashir Maken, citing an initial assessment, confirmed the casualties from the blast. He clarified that no law enforcement or security personnel were among the deceased, which included a Customs official and civilians.The deceased comprised nine men, two women and a minor.According to police and Rescue 1122 officials, an unidentified attacker rammed the explosives-laden tractor trolley into the checkpost. article.title: Blast in Dera Ismail Khan kills 11, injures 30: Rescue 1122
article.summary: At least 11 people were killed and 30 injured in a blast in Dera Ismail Khan on Saturday, emergency service Rescue 1122 said.Dera Ismail Khan, in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa near border regions with Afghanistan, has repeatedly been hit by terrorist violence, frequently targeting police and security forces.The Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP) claimed responsibility for Saturday’s attack.The blast occurred near Aman Mela in the Darazinda area of the district, Rescue 1122 said in a statement.Rescue teams from the Darazinda station reached the scene and began relief operations, providing medical assistance to the wounded and taking them to hospital, the service said.Security incidents have continued in the district this month, including attacks involving the TTP.
